newsitem.title: POLAND: Bank Handlowy IPO to target Polish retail players.
newsitem.headline: Bank Handlowy IPO to target Polish retail players.

text.p: The forthcoming public offering of Poland's Bank Handlowy SA is designed to stir up as much domestic retail demand as possible, the bank's president said on Monday.
"For us reaching out to Polish investors is very important and the structure of the public offering aims to achieve that goal," Cezary Stypulkowski told a news conference.
The state treasury is offering 15 percent of Handlowy's 65 million shares in a retail domestic tranche on subscription from May 26 to June 13. @

The treasury is offering another 30 percent to institutional investors and up to 42.86 percent of shares to a group of selected international financial institutions which would agree to keep Handlowy shares as a long-term investment.

Stypulkowski said that the privatisation plan envisaged shifting shares from other tranches to the retail offer if demand proves high and several incentives for Poles to bid for a chunk of the country's oldest financial institution. @

"If we manage to convince Poles that by buying shares of our bank they will invest in their future...we will be able to cover any demand from individual investors by the shares' supply," Artur Nieradko, an adviser of Handlowy's management, told Reuters.

Should the demand be high, retail investors may additionally be offered 7.5 percent of the tranche earmarked for the institutional investors, or about 4.9 million shares, and 14 percent of the tranche for stable investors, or 9.1 million shares, he said. @

Another 3.6 percent of shares from the stable investors' tranche may be offered as so-called premium shares to those small investors who will buy a certain number of shares and keep them until the end of the year.
As another incentive, small investors would be entitled to buy Handlowy's shares with a five-percent discount if they subscribe for them between May 23 and June 6.
The discount will be three percent for small investors subscribing between June 7 and June 13.
